newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTORCYCLING-VICTORY LEAVES CORSER CLOSE TO SUPERBIKE TITLE.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-VICTORY LEAVES CORSER CLOSE TO SUPERBIKE TITLE.

text.p: Australian rider Troy Corser took a giant step towards the world superbike championship on Sunday by winning both races in the penultimate meeting of the season.
Corser, who took both races by comfortable margins, was followed home by Americans Colin Edwards and John Kocinski in the first, and by the same pair in reverse order in the second.
After 11 races and with just one remaining, Corser leads the world championship standings with 353 points, 26 ahead of New Zealander Aaron Slight, with Kocinski another 10 points further back.
